name: Card toploader
definition: rigid plastic holder made to hold one card, sold apart from soft sleeves.
notes: The Pennysleever shop menu has Toploaders as its own category.

name: Card sleeve
definition: soft clear sleeve made to hold one card (penny sleeve), sold apart from rigid toploaders.
notes: The Pennysleever shop menu lists Card Sleeves as a category separate from Toploaders.

name: Stamp hinge
definition: small folded gummed paper piece that fixes one stamp to an album page, sold apart from mounts.
notes: Harry Edelman has a Stamp Hinges category beside separate Hawid, Prinz and Showgard mount headings.
